title: Carrots by the Millimeter  (밀리미터 단위로 썬 당근)

segments.t: 수요일 오전 열 시, 오븐 안에서는 빵 덩어리들이 노릇노릇 구워지고, 케일럽이 테사와 오언 곁 도마 앞에 서서 자로 잰 듯 반듯한 당근과 양파 큐브를 줄 세워 썰고 있어요. 먼저 세 사람의 대화를 들어 보세요.
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
두 형제가 나란히 수프를 끓이는 정겨운 대화를 한 줄씩 살펴볼까요.
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
'케일럽의 도마 좀 봐요, 테사. 당근 큐브 하나하나가 똑같이 생겼어요!'
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
'크기가 고른 큐브라야 정확히 같은 속도로 익거든요, 형. 기초 물리학이죠!'
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
'마음껏 웃어요, 오언, 우리 주방에서 본 수프 재료 손질 중 가장 반듯하니까요!'
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
'올리브유를 두른 냄비가 달궈졌어요. 양파와 당근을 지금 넣을까요?'
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
'네! 단맛이 올라올 때까지 삼 분간 볶다가 붉은 렌틸콩과 뜨거운 육수를 부어 주세요.'
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
'다음엔 안뜰에서 딴 타임과 파슬리가 필요한가요, 셰프님?'
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
'실로 묶은 신선한 허브 두 줄기에다 마지막에 소금 한 꼬집을 더해 주세요.'
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
'돌 주방에서 수프가 보글보글 끓는 소리를 듣는 건 언제든 도심 교통 소음보다 훨씬 낫네요.'
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
'참 신기하구나. 삼 년 전엔 전화기를 붙들고 다퉜는데, 오늘은 우리가 함께 수프를 끓이고 있으니 말이야.'
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
'다시는 삼 년씩이나 기다렸다가 형한테 전화하는 일 없도록 제게 꼭 일깨워 주세요, 오언 형.'
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
'자자, 형제분들, 눈물은 아껴 두세요. 제 빵 타이머가 울리고 있거든요!'
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
'오븐 장갑 끼고! 겉이 바삭한 빵 여덟 덩어리가 뜨겁게 나옵니다!'
향긋한 주방의 대화를 처음부터 다시 들어 보세요.
Look at Caleb's cutting board, Tessa: every carrot cube is identical!
Even cubes cook at the exact same speed, brother. Basic physics!
Laugh all you want, Owen, that is the neatest soup prep my kitchen has ever seen!
Pot is warm with olive oil. Onions and carrots going in now?
Yes! Stir three minutes until sweet, then add red lentils and hot broth.
Need the courtyard thyme and parsley next, Chef?
Two fresh sprigs tied with string, plus one pinch of salt at the end.
Listening to soup simmer in a stone kitchen beats city traffic any day.
Funny: three years ago we argued on the phone, and today we make soup together.
Remind me never to wait three years to call you again, Owen.
All right, brothers, save the tears. My bread timer is ringing!
Oven mitts on! Eight crusty loaves coming out hot!
노릇하게 구워진 빵 여덟 덩어리가 오븐에서 나오고, 두 형제가 나란히 끓인 렌틸콩 수프도 깊게 우러납니다. 이따가 다음 장면에서 만나요.
See you later!
